slides.title: Searchable Monthly Detail Reports
slides.text: Dashboard detail views now include Excel and PDF downloads, instant search across dates, duty times, overtime reasons and notes, plus a refined desktop table layout while preserving the mobile card experience.

slides.title: Interactive Dashboard Insights
slides.text: Dashboard statistics are now interactive. Open Working Days, Day Off, Leave, Overtime or Holiday Worked to review the selected month's underlying dates and attendance details, including overtime reasons and notes where recorded.

slides.title: Excel Download Compatibility Fix
slides.text: Improves roster Excel downloads on Android by generating a correctly typed XLSX file with the official Excel MIME type and month-specific filename.

slides.title: Monthly Roster Downloads
slides.text: Roster PDF and Excel downloads now follow the selected month. Choose Previous, Current, or Next month and export only that month's roster entries.

slides.title: Quick Actions Upgrade
slides.text: Replaces the duplicate Add attendance Quick Action with Bus & Shuttles, opening the existing Bus & Shuttle Time page directly. The main Add attendance button remains available on the homepage.

slides.title: Footer Placement Fix
slides.text: Moves the WorkTrack footer below the Bus & Shuttle Time section so the page footer appears at the bottom after the timetable content. No attendance calculations, saved records, or transport times are changed.
